lines.en: Sara, my old washing machine used to work perfectly. Now it stops in the middle.

lines.en: How old is it? We used to have the same model in my old house.
lines.pt: Quantos anos ela tem? A gente tinha o mesmo modelo na minha casa velha.

lines.en: It is twelve years old. I used to wash clothes by hand when I was young.

lines.en: Really? My grandmother used to wash everything in the river.
lines.pt: Sério? Minha avó lavava tudo no rio.

lines.en: Things used to last longer, I think. Now every appliance breaks after a few years.

items.wrong: I use to work in Dallas.

items.why: For past habits, use used to.
Use the base verb after used to.

items.wrong: Did you used to live here?

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.

group: Compare erro e forma natural: I use to work in Dallas. → I used to work in Dallas. | She used to worked here. → She used to work here. | Did you used to live here? → Did you use to live here?.
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.

facts.label: Used to
facts.sub: Afirmativo: used to work. Negativo: didn’t use to work. Pergunta: Did you use to work? Sem d depois de did.

facts.label: Costumava
facts.sub: Use used to + verbo base para falar de algo do passado que não é mais verdade: I used to wash clothes by hand. It used to be quiet. Pode ser hábito ou situação. Não é uma ação repetida no presente.

facts.label: Não costumava
facts.sub: No negativo, use didn’t use to, sem o d final: It didn’t use to make noise. O verbo did já mostra o passado. Por isso, depois de didn’t, não escrevemos used.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Used to talks about the past.
After used to, we use the base verb.

items.why: We say: I used to work.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Used to talks about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After used to, we use the base verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes: used to work.)
We say “I used to worked”. → Falso (We say: I used to work.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: In questions, we say “Did you use to…?”.
Used to is for the present.

answers: In questions, we say “Did you use to…?”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Used to is for the present. → Falso (It is for the past.)

pages.title: An old machine in Dallas · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot afternoon in Dallas. Beth stands in her small laundry room. Her old machine is full of wet clothes. It has stopped in the middle of the cycle. Her friend Sara comes to see it. They talk about how things were before.

“Sara, my old washing machine used to work perfectly. Now it stops in the middle.” says Beth. “Did it use to make noise? Mine used to shake a lot.” says Sara. “No, it didn’t use to make any noise. It used to be very quiet.” says Beth.
